test.create_query: CREATE TABLE ts_addmany (id UInt16, timestamp DateTime, value Float64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (id, timestamp)
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO ts_addmany SELECT (number % 1000)::UInt16 AS id, toDateTime(intDiv(number, 1000)) AS timestamp, (intDiv(number, 1000) % 1000)::Float64 AS value FROM numbers(1000 * 10000)
test.query: SELECT id, timeSeriesRateToGrid(0, 10000, 100, 300)(timestamp, value) FROM ts_addmany GROUP BY id FORMAT Null
